data.body:
[P2] Match completed receipts independently of array order

The shared iterator consumes unmatched receipts. For partial receipts `[A, B]` from different requests and completed receipts `[B, A]`, searching for A consumes B, which is then incorrectly reported missing. Cross-request array order is not an evidence identity, so valid cleanup is rejected and the profile is quarantined solely because records were reordered. Use one-to-one identity matching independent of array position, preserving multiplicity, and add a regression with reordered completed receipts.
